name: Alberto Zamora
profile: Co-founded osapiens in Mannheim in 2018 with Stefan Wawrzinek and Matthias Jungblut. Its osapiens HUB handles supply-chain transparency, ESG/EUDR compliance and operations for 2,500+ companies in 60+ countries; it became a unicorn in Jan 2026 after a $100M Series C led by BlackRock and Temasek.
interesting_fact: He and his co-founders won EY Entrepreneur Of The Year Germany 2026 (Young Companies); he accepted the award in Munich on 5 Nov 2026.
deep_cut_fact: osapiens won the German Founder's Award (Deutscher Gründerpreis) in 2022, and its first outside capital was a EUR 25M round from Armira Growth.
notes: Strong fit for an energy/carbon/supply-chain angle.

name: Jin Xianmin
current_role: Founder and CEO, TuringQ (图灵量子), Shanghai; Distinguished Professor, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
profile: Physicist (金贤敏) who founded TuringQ, a photonic quantum-computing and photonic-chip company spun out of SJTU's Center for Integrated Quantum Information Technology, which he set up after returning to China in 2014. He is a Changjiang Scholar, directs SJTU's IQIT and heads the Wuxi photonic chip institute CHIPX.
interesting_fact: TuringQ (founded 2021) built China's first photonic-chip pilot line with SJTU/CHIPX and a quantum-AI computing center; it holds 200+ patents.
deep_cut_fact: Before returning to China he was an EU Marie Curie Fellow and a scholar at Wolfson College, Oxford; his PhD thesis won China's national 'Top 100 Excellent Doctoral Dissertations' award.
notes: Mainly Chinese-language presence; academic profile at SJTU physics. Relevant to compute/data-center (photonic computing) angle.
